user.title: New weather station
user.description: Choose the contact sensor of your tipping-bucket rain gauge: every state change (open ↔ closed) counts as one tip.

data_description.mm_per_tip: Amount of rain (mm) for one tip of the bucket. Can be changed later in the options.
data_description.import_history: Replays the tips still kept in the Home Assistant history (10 days by default) so totals do not start from zero.

sensors.title: Other sensors
sensors.description: Optionally add the other sensors of {station_name}: they feed the dashboard and its charts. All are optional. With temperature and humidity, the dew point and the feels-like temperature are computed.

data_description.forecast_entity: An existing weather entity (Met.no, Météo-France…) lending its forecasts to the station and completing the sky condition when the station does not measure it.

reconfigure.title: Change sensors
reconfigure.description: Select the sensors of {station_name}. Clear a field to stop showing that sensor. Changing the rain gauge resets the totals.

data_description.forecast_entity: An existing weather entity (Met.no, Météo-France…) lending its forecasts to the station and completing the sky condition when the station does not measure it.

error.rain_already_used: This rain gauge is already used by another station.

abort.already_configured: This rain gauge is already used by a station.

data_description.mm_per_tip: The new value also applies to the totals already recorded.
data_description.debounce_seconds: Ignores a tip coming less than this delay after the previous one (contact bounce). 0 counts everything.
data_description.rain_window_minutes: Without any tip for this delay, the rain is considered over.

reset.title: Reset measurements
reset.description: Resets every rain measurement of {station_name}: today's, this week's, this month's and this year's totals, total rain, rolling rain and last rain. The history of the rain charts (7 days, 30 days, rain per month) is cleared too. This cannot be undone.

data_description.confirm: Tick the box and submit to reset everything.

alerts.title: Alert thresholds
alerts.description: The "Frost risk" and "Strong wind" sensors turn on when these thresholds are crossed. Every alert start and end fires the weather_station_alert event, to send notifications from your automations.

data_description.frost_threshold: Air temperature from which ground frost is likely. The alert ends 1 °C above.
data_description.wind_threshold: Gusts (or mean wind without a gust sensor) starting the alert. It ends below 80 % of the threshold.

error.confirm_required: Tick the confirmation box to reset the measurements.

abort.station_not_loaded: The station is not loaded: try again once the integration has started.

reset_rain.name: Reset rain measurements
reset_rain.description: Resets every rain measurement of a station and clears the history of its rain charts. Cannot be undone.

station_not_loaded.message: This Weather Station does not exist or is not loaded.
